description: This file defines the AesDecryptingStream class which implements an interface for streaming decryption of data using AES cipher methods, primarily for in-memory decryption in a PHP SDK context.

classes.name: AesDecryptingStream
classes.description: A class that provides a decrypting stream for AES encrypted data, allowing for sequential reading and decryption of data on-the-fly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decrypting stream with the given cipher text stream, key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name associated with the current cipher method.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES cipher method name.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Retrieves the current initialization vector used in the cipher method.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the decrypted data if available, null if padding is required.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable, always returns false for this decrypting stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and decrypts data from the stream, returning the requested length.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning; other seeks are unsupported and will throw an exception.
